name: Kill The Sea
description:
About This Game

Kill The Sea is a seafaring sandbox survivors-like where you command a heavily armed vessel across a strange and hostile ocean. Hunt menacing beasts of legend, complete deliveries, win races, defend outposts, find treasures or gamble it all in an oceanic world driven by chaos, risk, and opportunity.

Chart a course through the legendary Seven Seas -- seven distinct regions packed with deadly threats, unpredictable encounters, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Progress through a campaign where every sea introduces new challenges and surprises. Journey to uncharted islands to find upgradable outposts to bolster your naval might. The seas are treacherous, so manage your cargo carefully!

Recruit a bizarre cast of sailors, specialists, and questionably qualified seafarers. Each crew member features unique abilities and promotion paths that dramatically alter your builds, tactics, and combat style. Experiment with strange synergies, risky upgrades, and unexpected strategies.

Kill The Sea is a high-energy auto-shooter focused on fast gameplay and deep customization. On launch, Early Access will include:

  • 3 sea regions (7 in release)

  • 3 seacrafts (7 in release)

  • 10 crew members (14 in release)

  • 10 weapons (28 in release)

  • 18 items (35 in release)

  • 16 enemy types (25 in release)

  • 3 boss fights (7 in release)

Throughout Early Access, we'll introduce more features to complete the full experience, which will include:

  • A campaign spanning seven seas, each with its own unique flavor, challenges, and win conditions

  • A wacky roster of specialized crew members with unique promotion paths

  • Distinct unlockable weapons, seacrafts, and equipment

  • Bosses, enemies, quests, hazards and environmental effects
